text:
sarah-sales: Quick Q — enterprise wants tenant geofence: all inference + KMS keys resident in eu-west, and strict no-cross-border egress for EU tenants. They want an explicit subprocessors list and a pricing delta for residency. Can this be done on Hosted or do they need Dedicated/Private? cc @owen-se @maria-security

owen-se: Short answer: doable but depends on enforcement level. Hosted supports tenant pinning and preferred-region routing but cannot guarantee zero cross-region egress under overload unless you reserve capacity in the target region. For strict no-cross-border you should use Dedicated or Private with residency enforcement. For Hosted we can set `residency_mode: best_effort` vs `strict`.

maria-security: KMS notes: Hosted supports customer-managed keys in supported regions (we can bind a key in eu-cloud for encrypting at rest), but BYOK with customer KMS is fully supported only on Private. Subprocessors: I'll attach the current list (monitoring, CDN, infra) — but short version: primary infra + cloud provider region services, CDN edge partner (some edges in APAC), and telemetry processor. We'll need explicit subproc language in DPA for strict residency.

raj-solutions: POC suggestion: 1) capture traffic profile (QPS, avg tokens). 2) provision small dedicated eu pool (pinned tenant). 3) run smoke tests for egress + KMS wrap/unwarp. 4) cost sim for 7 days. I can run the POC if customer commits to a small reserved capacity for the trial.

lena-ps: Pricing note: dedicated eu pool increases baseline due to reserved GPU hours. Ballpark: strict residency (dedicated) + BYOK -> ~30–50% uplift vs shared hosted for steady workloads. For a POC estimate I need expected qps, p95 tokens/request, and retention window for logs.

chris-legal: Flag: customer asks "no subprocessors outside EU" — that's tricky because some CDN edges/monitoring vendors may be global. We can negotiate contract addendum to limit subproc use for the tenant and require us to cascade EU-only processing where feasible. I'll prepare contract language and DPA addendum.

deploy-bot: capacity-check: eu-dedicated-pool nodes=12, spare-throughput-estimate=1200rps

sarah-sales: Helpful — they want a quote by EoW and a short POC checklist. Also asked if model evals / RLHF telemetry could be prevented from leaving EU — what's our stance?

maria-security: Telemetry: we aggregate metrics; retention and export settings are configurable. For strict residency we can disable telemetry exports outside EU and keep logs in-region for the agreed retention. Will mark on the security questionnaire.

owen-se: Sample POC routing snippet you can share with ops/eng: 
```
routing_policy:
  tenant_pin: eu-west-1
  residency_mode: strict
  fallback: reject
  kms: customer-kms-eu
```
Note: `residency_mode: strict` + `fallback: reject` on Hosted will cause requests to return 429 when eu capacity is saturated; to avoid errors use Dedicated reserve.

raj-solutions: I'll draft SOW + POC checklist and propose Wed 11am sync with the customer. Who can attend?

sarah-sales: I'm in. @lena-ps can you produce tentative pricing scenarios before the sync? @chris-legal please add DPA note.

lena-ps: Yep, I'll do a 3-tier estimate (small/medium/large) and include committed vs burst pricing.

chris-legal: I'll add contract caveats and a subproc appendix.

sarah-sales: Awesome — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
